News Update | Zuko Nonxuba payouts

By: Stenette Grosskopf | Paid

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
After years of inaction, the LPC is forced to compensate the victims of attorney, Zuko Nonxuba...

Unique Selling Point:
Zuko Nonxuba, an attorney from the Eastern Cape, was first exposed on Carte Blanche in early 2023. For years he had been litigating medical malpractice cases against the Department of Health.. And won millions of rands in compensation for his desperate clients… But his clients saw very little of this money, and the Legal Practice Council seemed indifferent to the suffering children. But now, a group of lawyers have taken on the LPC, forcing them to make sure the victims get the money due to them.

Summary:
A team of lawyers acting for victims of disgraced attorney Zuko Nonxuba have secured a court order giving the Legal Practice Council (LPC) strict timelines to complete its investigations into the alleged R348m plunder of his trust funds, and to pay out any proven claims.

Among the victims are dozens of children with cerebral palsy whose parents and guardians, through Nonxuba’s firm, sued the department of health for medical negligence. The department paid over millions of rand into the firm’s trust account. But, it is alleged, Nonxuba stole the money.

Further information:
Attorneys from Andraos and Hatchett, assisted by advocates Nazeer Cassim SC and Mohammed Desai, launched an urgent application in the Johannesburg high court against the LPC and the Legal Practitioners Fidelity Fund, seeking to support the victims and ensure they get what is legally theirs.

A settlement agreement with the LPC now puts pressure on it to take swift action.

In their heads of argument, which came before Judge Ingrid Opperman, they said: “This matter cries out for the attention of this court and the assistance of the legal profession. It is a lawyer, Mr Nonxuba, who perpetrated the most heinous acts on the minor children who all suffer from the debilitating condition of cerebral palsy. It is thus fitting that the legal profession set right the malevolence of one of its own.”

At present, the legal team is acting for two guardians of two children. But it is believed there are more than 30 claimants.

Script:


News Update | Zuko Nonxuba payouts – Script

VO
He allegedly plundered an estimated R348 million from trust funds.
VO
Money that was meant to help suffering children… and their desperate families…
VO
His name: Zuko Nonxuba.


[pause]
VO
In April 2023, we met Avile Molose… a young boy living with cerebral palsy as a result of birth injuries at a state hospital…

His mother was struggling financially, and Avile was clearly suffering…
UPS
It’s not easy. I want my child to go to school. I want him to have a wheelchair.
VO
But Avile’s life was supposed to be so much better…

Thanks to attorney Zuko Nonxuba, a successful medical negligence claim was brought against the Department of Health.

Avile’s Mother, Millicent, should have received a R15 million payout… but she only got a fraction of that…
UPS
He gave me R50 000.
VO
But Avile is not the only victim, for years Nonxuba was allegedly making a very lucrative career out of medical malpractice litigation on behalf of vulnerable clients…
Cameron
The allegations stipulate, Mr Nonxuba received these monies on behalf of the children and misappropriated them. When he was called to account, account for these monies he could not.
VO



Cameron Hatchett is part of a team of legal heavyweights that stepped up to help Avile and Nonxuba’s other victims.
Cameron
These are the most vulnerable members of society and it truly is a heartbreaking story that they have been taken advantage of in this way.
VO
Complaints about Nonxuba’s practices go back as far as 2013… and yet the Legal Practice Council – the statutory body that oversees all legal practitioners – took years to investigate and take action – an allegation they disputed when interviewed by us last year.
VO
Nonxuba was finally suspended in August 2023, and the LPC now manages the former attorney’s trust accounts…


Cameron
The Legal Practice Council currently holds a vast amount of money on behalf of these children and unfortunately the money was frozen.
VO
At the end of January the Legal team had their first significant success… after approaching the Gauteng high court to help the children get the money that is rightfully theirs…
Cameron
What this court order has done is set a plan in place to make sure the victims can be identified… However we’ll be ecstatic when the money actually arrives, and these children get the care and the assistance they so desperately need.
